title: Nourishing Hearty Ethiopian Lamb Berbere Stew
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring tender lamb in a rich and spicy berbere sauce, served in a kazan cauldron. This earthy and chewy stew is perfect for special occasions and festivals.
instructions: Heat oil in a large kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the berbere spice mix, chili powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and beef broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 1.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, the stew is served with injera bread for scooping up the sauce.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
